spec.name: Furniture Gothic Gargoyle
spec.description: A crouching weathered stone gargoyle with a heavy muzzle, pointed ears, short horns and folded stepped bat wings. Planted forepaws, muscular haunches and a tucked tail connect it to a low square plinth. Moss gathers in sheltered creases. Front faces negative Z; all geometry is axis-aligned and within the requested margins.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: crouching weathered stone gargoyle on a short square plinth, folded stepped bat wings, pointed ears, small horns and moss in the stone creases. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..16, y=0..32, z=0..16; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Standing on floor y=0. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges.  Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
